description: This source file defines the PassthroughEndpointRouter class, which manages credentials for pass-through endpoints in a machine learning or API integration context. It includes methods for setting and retrieving credentials, configuring default environment-based settings, adding specific vertex credentials, and interacting with vector store registries.
